MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_CWT_rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ONLY_CWT_rf dominates across all dimensions with perfect trend correlation (1.0), highest seasonal correlation (0.5746), and lowest RMSE (86.48). The extreme RMSE spread ratio (46.29) and high seasonality variance indicate significant model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to exploit decomposition structure while handling variance. Different horizon specialists (DWT_rf early, CWT_rf late) suggest per-horizon weighting could further improve performance.
